lines.en: I decide to spend my afternoon at the library, listening to Nodoka rant on and on about poets and playwrights who have been dead for very long amounts of time.
lines.zh: 我决定在图书馆消磨这个下午，听 Nodoka 没完没了地念叨那些早就死了很久的诗人和剧作家。

lines.en: But despite my apparent days of loving things like this being long in the past, I don't ever find myself getting bored.
lines.zh: 虽然我显然早就过了喜欢这些东西的年纪，我却一次都没觉得无聊。

lines.en: She speaks in a way that manages to captivate a side of me that has long since passed, and I can't help but internally thank her for being able to do that.
lines.zh: 她说话的方式，能攫住我心里某个早已逝去的部分，我忍不住在心里默默感谢她能做到这一点。

lines.en: I'd love to thank her on an actual person-to-person basis, but thanking people is tiring. Especially when you can't fully understand what you're thanking them for.
lines.zh: 我也想当着面好好道个谢，可道谢太累了。尤其是当你根本搞不清自己到底在谢什么的时候。

lines.en: What I mean to say is that I manage to enjoy my time in a sun-soaked wooden room with a girl who smells like fresh coffee.
lines.zh: 我想说的是——我确实很享受在洒满阳光的木屋里，和一个身上有现磨咖啡味的女孩共度的时光。

lines.en: I lose myself in the moment and close my eyes.
lines.zh: 我沉溺在这一刻里，闭上了眼睛。

lines.en: I think Nodoka closes hers as well, since our conversation abruptly halts and we spend the next ten minutes sitting in silence.
lines.zh: 我觉得 Nodoka 也闭上了眼，因为我们的对话戛然而止，接下来的十分钟我们都只是静静地坐着。

lines.en: I can only remain this despondent for so long, however, so I decide to reclaim my consciousness and head out after saying goodbye.
lines.zh: 但我没办法一直这么消沉下去，于是我决定找回意识，道完别就走。

lines.en: Right before diving headfirst into more words from someone who can no longer speak.
lines.zh: 随即又一头扎进那些再也不能开口的人留下的文字里。
Nodoka 的好感度提升到了 [nodoka_love]！
